findings.summary: The page never handles query.isError or query.isLoading, so on a failed fetch it silently renders only the header with no metrics or data, unlike the sibling DisputesPage which shows an EmptyState error banner.
findings.fix: Mirror DisputesPage: after PageHeader render `{query.isError ? <EmptyState title="تعذر تحميل بيانات الحضور" description={query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : 'تحقق من الاتصال والصلاحيات.'} /> : null}` and gate on a loading state (LoadingScreen or a skeleton) while query.isLoading.

findings.summary: The 'فترات الحضور' list renders `data?.periods.map(...)` with no EmptyState fallback, so an empty result shows a bare empty container, inconsistent with the EmptyState used for rosters/corrections.
findings.fix:
Wrap with the same pattern: `{data && data.periods.length === 0 ? :
…
}`.

findings.summary: The 'العمل الإضافي' list renders `data?.overtime.map(...)` with no EmptyState fallback, showing an empty container when there are no overtime requests.
findings.fix: Add an EmptyState fallback matching the corrections pattern, e.g. `{data && data.overtime.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="لا يوجد عمل إضافي" description="طلبات العمل الإضافي في الشهر المحدد ستظهر هنا." /> : …}`.

findings.summary: The clickable shift cards use a bespoke `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` button with no hover affordance, instead of the shared `.card-interactive` interaction style used for clickable cards.
findings.fix: Add the `card-interactive` class (and cursor/hover) to the shift `<button>`, e.g. `className="card-interactive rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4 text-right"` so it matches the app's interactive-card feedback.

findings.summary: The 'إغلاق الشهر' primary button has no disabled/pending state while commands.closePeriod is running, unlike saveShift (line 42) which disables on isPending.
findings.fix: Add `disabled={commands.closePeriod.isPending}` to the إغلاق الشهر button for consistent submit feedback.

findings.summary: The month picker in PageHeader actions is a bare `<label>` wrapping the input with the text 'الشهر' glued directly to the field and no aria-label, giving a cramped, unlabeled-in-AT control.
findings.fix: Give the input `aria-label="الشهر"` and separate the visible label text (e.g. wrap the caption in a `<span className="block">` or add spacing) so the label reads clearly in RTL and to screen readers.

findings.summary: Section cards use repeated inline `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` article wrappers across corrections/periods/overtime instead of a shared record-card class, duplicating styling that could drift from the design system.
findings.fix: Extract the repeated `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` into a shared class (e.g. reuse `.mobile-record-card` or a new `.record-card`) and apply it to these article wrappers for consistency.

findings.summary: The corrections empty check `data?.corrections.length === 0` evaluates false while data is undefined (loading), so during load nothing renders with no skeleton, matching a pattern that lacks any loading placeholder.
findings.fix: Once a loading state is added (see line 18 finding), render a lightweight skeleton or spinner for these lists while query.isLoading rather than an empty gap.
